generatedFrom: 2026-10-21 compact markdown renderer for workspace notes: dependency-free inline tokens, inert raw HTML, safe-protocol-only links opened through the external command

rows.note: Compact variant renders paragraphs as spans, applies remark-breaks and the card typography; react-markdown is now the engine.
H1–H6 render as inline spans with role=heading and the original aria-level; no block heading tags.
Document variant renders block headings with hierarchy, paragraphs, quotes and rules; verified by render tests.
Raw HTML is parsed then sanitized with rehype-sanitize; event handlers and unsafe protocols cannot survive.
Links preventDefault+stopPropagation and open via open_external_url_cmd; auxclick is routed the same way.
